subject: ShopStack demo request — use case & traffic snapshot
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@shopstack.io>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ShopStack demo request — use case & traffic snapshot

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow — we just signed up and I wanted to see if we could book a short demo to run through a specific workload. High level: ShopStack is an e-commerce search + recommendations product for independent retailers. We're looking to add semantic embeddings for product search and a reranker for recommendations. A few context points that will shape the demo: 

- Current traffic: ~1.2M queries/day across our API (peak days hit higher).
- Peak QPS: roughly 150–200 (short spikes during new collection drops).
- Average user input length: ~45–70 tokens.
- Candidate set size: 10k–50k depending on retailer.
- Read-heavy: ~80% inference for rerank/search; writes are low.
- Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks if everything looks good.

I've attached a small traffic snapshot (traffic_snapshot_q2.csv) and a heatmap export from our analytics. For the demo we'd like to see: model pairing suggestions for embeddings + reranking, typical latency/cost tradeoffs at our QPS pattern, and an outline for pilot capacity/rollout.

Could you propose a 25–30 minute slot? We're PST-based and prefer mornings (9–11am PST) next week.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Head of Product, ShopStack
samira@shopstack.io

Attachment: traffic_snapshot_q2.csv (CSV, 120KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@shopstack.io>
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ShopStack demo request — use case & traffic snapshot

Hi Samira — welcome and great context, thanks for the snapshot. I can take first pass on scheduling and a few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the demo: 

1) Can you confirm sustained baseline QPS vs burst peak (example: sustained 30–60 QPS, bursts to 180)?
2) Are you expecting to host any model or infra on-prem / in your VPC for the pilot, or is hosted API fine for initial evaluation?
3) Do you need embeddings and reranking to be strongly consistent across replicas (affects cache strategy)?
4) Do you have an SSO requirement / SAML?

If morning PST works, here are three 30-minute windows next week I have open: 
- Tue 2025-08-19 09:30–10:00 PDT
- Wed 2025-08-20 10:00–10:30 PDT
- Thu 2025-08-21 09:00–09:30 PDT

I'll include a short pre-demo checklist (attached) that helps our engineering team focus the demo (tokens per request examples, a sample query, and an allowlist for test API keys). If none of those times work, tell me a couple of slots and we can move things.

Booking link: https://cal.redwood.ai/b/ben/30min
Pre-demo checklist attached: pre-demo-checklist.pdf

—Ben
Ben Carter | SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Samira Khan <samira@shopstack.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-12T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ShopStack demo request — use case & traffic snapshot

Thanks Ben — answers inline below.

1) Sustained baseline: ~40–55 QPS; recent marketing drops push to 180 QPS for 3–5 minute bursts.
2) Pilot deployment: hosted API is fine for pilot; we may evaluate VPC/Private for production.
3) Consistency: eventual is fine for reranker; we do not require strong cross-replica KV sync initially.
4) SSO: yes, SAML for our admins during pilot would be required.

Any of the Tue/Wed/Thu slots you suggested could work — Wed 10:00 PDT is ideal for our engineers. We'll have myself + one backend engineer (Carlos) join.

Let me know if you need any more telemetry in advance.

Samira

Hi Samira — great to meet you and thanks for the details. Wed 2025-08-20 10:00–10:30 PDT is confirmed on our side (Google Calendar invite attached). We'll run a focused 25-minute demo tailored to your traffic heatmap and then 5 minutes for next steps/pilot scoping. Agenda (short):

1) Quick intro & goals (2–3 min)
2) Traffic heatmap walk-through + model pairing suggestions (8–10 min)
3) Live demo: embeddings + reranker latency at your QPS profile (8–10 min)
4) Pilot outline: capacity, monitoring, security checklist (4–5 min)

Attendees from our side: Evelyn (solutions lead), Ben (SDR/ops), and our Security engineering rep (to cover SAML/KMS questions). Please share Carlos' calendar invite if you'd like him included. I've dropped a short analysis link for the heatmap here: https://drive.redwood.ai/ShopStack/pre-demo-heatmap — feel free to upload any small logs (redacted) there.

If you need to shift the time, reply with two alternative windows and we'll swap.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
